skill.pageDescription.zh: 查看系统、公共和用户私有 Skill 的资产状态
skill.pageDescription.en: View asset status of system, public, and user-private skills

skill.applyStatusToast.zh: {{name}} 已{{action}}，Skill 变更将自动同步到所有 Pod。
skill.applyStatusToast.en: {{name}} has been {{action}}. Skill changes will sync to all Pods.

skill.applyAllContent.en: Syncs public skills and applies the latest skill config to all running Pods.

skill.applyAllSynced.zh: Skill 已同步：{{synced}} 个 Pod 已刷新文件。{{suffix}}

skill.applySubmitted.zh: Skill 应用已提交：{{queued}} 个 Pod 排队，{{synced}} 个已同步，{{failed}} 个同步失败，{{failedQueue}} 个排队失败，{{skipped}} 个未运行跳过。{{suffix}}
skill.applySubmitted.en: Skill apply submitted: {{queued}} queued, {{synced}} synced, {{failed}} failed to sync, {{failedQueue}} failed to queue, {{skipped}} skipped (not running). {{suffix}}

skill.pvcCreatedPending.en: Public Skill PVC created, waiting for binding

skill.autoSyncTooltip.zh: Skill 变更自动同步；如需强制重同步可点击「应用 Skill」
skill.autoSyncTooltip.en: Skill changes sync automatically; click "Apply Skills" to force a resync

skill.storageUnconfigured.en: The backend is in K8s mode, but k8s.skillsPVC or k8s.publicSkillsMountPath is not configured. Configure the Public Skill storage and restart the Console.

skill.pvcNotReady.en: Public Skill PVC is not ready

skill.storageNotReady.zh: {{message}}。上传 Public Skill 前需要先创建并等待 PVC 绑定。
skill.storageNotReady.en: {{message}}. Create the PVC and wait for it to bind before uploading Public Skills.

skill.statusUpdateHint.en: This updates the control-plane config; skill changes will sync to all Pods.

skill.statusDeleteHint.en: Deleting removes the Console-managed Public Skill directory; after applying skills it will be removed from the public skill directory of all Pods.

platform.deleteHint.en: Deleting removes the platform and clears the platform credentials bound to all users.
